article_content: Dallas billionaire Samuel Wyly has filed for bankruptcy protection, citing inability to pay nearly $400 million in penalties for hiding stock holdings. Wyly, the former owner of the Michaels arts-and-crafts empire, filed a Chapter 11 bankruptcy petition in federal district court in Dallas. His biggest liabilities include an unknown amount to the IRS and $198 million to the SEC.

article_content: The parents of two teenagers in Georgia have been charged with child cruelty after police discovered the boys were living in deplorable conditions in a home infested with cockroaches and feces. Greg and Jackie Tate of Gwinnett County were arrested on Friday after local police witnessed the conditions firsthand. The home, which has been condemned, has running water and electricity but no working toilets.
